verdict.rationale: The gateway explicitly exposes an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API and works with existing OpenAI client libraries and the Vercel AI SDK, both of which support streaming responses, implying token-by-token streaming works through the gateway for any provider it proxies. However, no evidence explicitly documents a `stream: true` parameter, SSE format, or confirms streaming behavior per-provider. Missing for 10: explicit streaming API documentation, confirmation across all providers, and independent/hands-on verification of streaming behavior.
